source_differences: Length: lift-world 118 m (matches the earlier note's ordinance value 118.21 m) vs English Wikipedia and Lonely Planet '70 m'. Lift-world gives 70 m as the vertical rise, supporting the note that '70 m' is the height difference.

Station elevations: lift-world 300 m / 370 m vs the note's ordinance values 294.5 m / 365 m. The ordinance docx on ljubljana.si was found but could not be read (binary), so the ordinance figures remain unverified here.
No station coordinate could be verified: Mapcarta pages for the stations were not returned by search, komoot 794344 (46.048506, 14.509414) is the castle itself, not a station.
Year: 2006 is the opening year of the funicular. The ZAG reference list gives the periodic inspections without a year.
